license_checked_on_page: License: Free (links to pexels.com/license); description 'Witness the powerful collapse of a Greenland iceberg into the ocean.' No AI label; creator is a broadcast cameraman/drone operator
title: Dramatic Arctic Iceberg Collapse in Greenland
notes: 4K drone shot downscaled to 1920x1080, 50->30 fps. 0-7 s: slow drone drift over turquoise water toward a tall ice wall with a dark cave/arch (x~0.6-0.75, y~0.25); a sculpted ice spire in the left foreground (x~0.1-0.2) slides out of frame as the camera moves. ~7.4 s the arch section starts to break (x~0.6, y~0.3); 8.4-10.5 s the whole wall section collapses into the sea, white ice avalanche (x~0.5-0.75); 10.5-14 s a huge ice-spray cloud rolls toward the camera and fills the frame. Shot A 4.8-7.4 (calm wall), shot B 8.2-10.8 (collapse), optional shot C 10.8-13.4 (spray cloud engulfs camera).
fact_en: Witness the powerful collapse of a Greenland iceberg into the ocean.
